attributes.description: This dashboard provides adversary intelligence insights into threat intelligence events detected in the user's environment by Google Threat Intelligence.

params.markdown:
This dashboard provides adversary intelligence insights into threat intelligence events detected in the user's environment by Google Threat Intelligence.

It categorizes detected threats into malware families, collections, campaigns, reports, software toolkits, threat actors, and vulnerabilities, using saved searches and uses metrics for count of unique adversaries.

[**Integrations Page**](/app/integrations/detail/ti_google_threat_intelligence/overview)
